Products and Platforms
 
 
Accelerating towards a digital future with our products and solutions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Our Approach
 
 
 
 
Tech Mahindra builds customized solutions for enterprises across industries and enable them to transform at speed, bring agility, resilience, and efficiency to their businesses. We strive to solve our customers’ real, on-ground challenges and help them transform their lives to create a better world.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our Platforms and Solutions 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
TechM Orion
 
 
A next-gen agentic AI platform, TechM Orion enables intelligent, autonomous execution of complex business workflows, helping enterprises achieve efficiency, scalability with good governance.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Yantr.ai
 
 
A platform providing end-to-end visibility by bringing together people, data, and technology for intelligent execution, improving the customer experience, and optimizing the cost of operations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Kornea
 
 
A cloud-native, AI-powered employee monitoring software – advanced employee productivity tracker and employee visibility solutions designed using computer vision tech and advanced analytics.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Populii
 
 
A platform for enterprises and gig workers, elevating AI systems to new heights with intelligent algorithms to collaborate and create faster, accurate AI-driven solutions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AceFin
 
 
A solution designed to provide actionable insights to CFOs from a single source of truth, assisting with timely decision making and enabling them to attain best in class standards of their industries.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AftEAZE
 
 
The platform, powered by Pega technology, manages the lifecycle of aftermarket operations and extended after-sales services. With AftEAZE, we deliver a configurable and modular platform to give your organization a connected and reliable aftermarket support system.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
netOps.ai
 
 
A secure and automated end-to-end cloud platform, enabling telco networks to empower their operators, accelerate digital transformation, and encourage the rapid deployment of 5G networks.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
MobiLytix
 
 
MobiLytix™ Marketing Studio provides marketers with integrated tools to seamlessly leverage advances in AI, real-time decisioning and digital marketing technology to power their customer value management (CVM) programs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Epselon
 
 
This platform enables customers to swiftly embark on digital transformation journey and provides enterprise baseline information of process complexities, usage, and insights to SAP and Oracle e-business suite.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Entellio
 
 
This is a robust and flexible end-to-end chatbot platform designed for enterprises that enhances and delivers optimal customer experiences across multiple channels
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Blue-marble
 
 
This is a digital transformation accelerator and offers a microservices based framework with a sharp focus on transforming existing IT systems and delivering digital experiences to our clients. It is based on a consistent, cloud-native, containerized deployment and runtime environment, with integrated support for a complete CI/CD pipeline.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
InfoWise ®
 
 
This is our solution for enterprise metadata 360 (augmented by AI) and RunOps transformation in digital spaces, providing a complete view of enterprise applications’ anatomy, their execution performance, and output consumption.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
hidden-link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Previous
 
Next
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Comviva
 
 
Comviva enhances Tech Mahindra's capabilities in the mobile VAS domain — providing us access to a marquee client base and enabling significant cross-selling opportunities. This enables us leverage and realize the potential of emerging technologies and offer differentiated mobile finance and customer management solutions for telecom operators across the world.
